vocabulary.meaning_en: the team that fixes computer problems in a company
vocabulary.note_ar: IT اختصار information technology، وتُنطق آي تي.
vocabulary.note_en: IT = information technology; say the letters I-T.
vocabulary.example: Call IT support if your computer stops working.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the use of computers to store and send information
vocabulary.example: She works in information technology.

vocabulary.meaning_en: when a computer screen stops and nothing moves
vocabulary.example: The screen keeps freezing.

vocabulary.meaning_en: when a computer suddenly stops working
vocabulary.example: My computer crashed and I lost my work.

vocabulary.meaning_en: files with writing on a computer
vocabulary.example: I seem to have lost some documents.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to go away so you can't see it
vocabulary.example: All my files have disappeared.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to stop a machine working with a button
vocabulary.example: Switch the computer off and on again.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to turn a computer off and on again
vocabulary.example: Try rebooting your laptop.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to repair
vocabulary.example: Turning it off and on hasn't fixed it.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the type of computer and software you use
vocabulary.example: What system are you using?

vocabulary.meaning_en: a small computer you can carry
vocabulary.example: I'm using a laptop.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a computer program
vocabulary.example: Were you using many applications?

vocabulary.meaning_en: a document with numbers in rows and columns
vocabulary.example: I keep the sales figures in a spreadsheet.

vocabulary.meaning_en: programs that run on a computer
vocabulary.example: We need to update the software.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the flat part of a computer where you see pictures and words
vocabulary.example: The screen has gone blank.

vocabulary.meaning_en: when a screen shows nothing
vocabulary.example: My computer's gone blank.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to make a copy of computer files in case they are lost
vocabulary.example: Always back up your important files.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a small device for storing computer files
vocabulary.note_ar: يسمى أيضًا USB stick / flash drive.
vocabulary.note_en: Also called a USB stick or flash drive.
vocabulary.example: Save a copy on a memory stick.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to take a plug out of the electric socket
vocabulary.example: Unplug the screen and plug it in again.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to make software or a machine newer or better
vocabulary.example: We need to upgrade our software.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to push a button or key
vocabulary.example: Press control, alt, delete at the same time.

vocabulary.meaning_en: stay calm
vocabulary.example: Don't panic! I'll come and have a look.

fine_lines.title: Windows vs windows
fine_lines.explanation_ar: Windows بحرف كبير هو اسم نظام تشغيل الحاسوب. windows بحرف صغير هي النوافذ في الجدار. هذا ما سبّب سوء الفهم في الحلقة.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Windows with a capital W is a computer operating system. Windows with a small w are the glass openings in a wall. This caused the joke in the episode.

examples.sentence: Could you open the windows? It's hot.

fine_lines.title: turn off vs turn on
fine_lines.explanation_ar: turn on يعني تشغيل الجهاز، و turn off يعني إطفاءه. ويمكن قول switch on / switch off بنفس المعنى.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Turn on means start a machine; turn off means stop it. Switch on/off means the same.

examples.sentence: Turn off your computer before you go home.

expressions.phrase: I am having problems with my computer.
expressions.meaning_en: Starting a call to IT support.
expressions.example: Hello, IT? I am having problems with my computer.
The screen keeps freezing when I open my email.

expressions.phrase: I seem to have lost some documents.
expressions.meaning_en: Describing lost files politely and carefully.
expressions.example: I seem to have lost some documents from yesterday.

expressions.phrase: I have turned the computer off and on but that hasn't fixed it.
expressions.meaning_ar: أطفأت الحاسوب وأعدت تشغيله لكن ذلك لم يحل المشكلة.
expressions.meaning_en: Saying what you have already tried.
expressions.example: I have turned the computer off and on but that hasn't fixed it.
My printer isn't working. Can you help, please?

expressions.meaning_en: How support staff answer the phone.
expressions.example: IT, Dave speaking, how can I help?

expressions.phrase: I'll come and have a look.
expressions.meaning_en: Offering to check a problem in person.
expressions.example: Don't panic! I'll come and have a look.

grammar.title: keep + verb-ing for repeated actions
grammar.explanation_ar: keep + الفعل مع ing تعني أن الشيء يتكرر باستمرار، وغالبًا بشكل مزعج: The screen keeps freezing (الشاشة تتجمد مرارًا).
grammar.explanation_en: keep + -ing means something happens again and again, often annoyingly: The screen keeps freezing.

grammar.title: seem to have + past participle
grammar.explanation_ar: seem to have + التصريف الثالث تُستخدم لوصف شيء حدث في الماضي دون تأكد تام، وهي أكثر تهذيبًا وحذرًا: I seem to have lost some documents.
grammar.explanation_en: seem to have + past participle describes a past event when you are not completely sure. It sounds careful and polite: I seem to have lost some documents.
examples: I seem to have lost some documents.
The file seems to have disappeared.
I seem to have deleted the wrong email.

grammar.title: Present perfect for what you have tried
grammar.explanation_ar: نستخدم المضارع التام لشرح ما جرّبناه قبل طلب المساعدة: I have turned it off and on, but that hasn't fixed it.
grammar.explanation_en: Use the present perfect to say what you have already tried: I have turned it off and on, but that hasn't fixed it.
examples: I have turned the computer off and on.

questions.question: What is the technical word for turning a computer off and on again?
questions.explanation_en: Reboot means turn it off and on again.

questions.question: Complete: 'The screen keeps ___.'
questions.explanation_ar: بعد keep نستخدم الفعل مع ing.

questions.question: Complete: 'I seem to have ___ some documents.'
questions.explanation_ar: seem to have + التصريف الثالث: lost.
questions.explanation_en: seem to have + past participle: lost.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.
choices: I turned the computer off and on but that hasn't fixing it.
I have turn the computer off and on but that hasn't fix it.
I have turned the computer off and on but that hasn't fixed it.
I have turning the computer off and on but that didn't fixed it.
questions.explanation_ar: المضارع التام: have + turned، hasn't + fixed.
questions.explanation_en: Present perfect: have + turned, hasn't + fixed.

questions.question: To make a copy of your files in case you lose them is to ___ them.
questions.explanation_en: Back up means make a safe copy.

questions.question: In the episode, 'open the windows' caused confusion. What did Dave from IT really mean?
questions.explanation_ar: كان يقصد نظام التشغيل Windows وليس نوافذ المكتب.
questions.explanation_en: He meant the Windows operating system.

questions.question: A document with numbers in rows and columns is a ___.
questions.explanation_en: A spreadsheet has rows and columns of numbers.

questions.question: How does Dave answer the phone?
choices: IT, Dave speaking, how can I help?
questions.explanation_ar: هذه طريقة مهنية لبدء مكالمة الدعم.
questions.explanation_en: This is the professional way to answer.

questions.question: 'My computer has gone blank' means…
questions.explanation_ar: go blank تعني أن الشاشة أصبحت فارغة.
questions.explanation_en: Go blank means the screen shows nothing.
